title: One product piece: admissibility for piece_current and the slice representation (supplied steps 2–3, per piece)
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ, L ≥ 0 (NNReal), G : ℝⁿ → ℝ^N L-Lipschitz, A ⊆ ℝⁿ Borel, w : ℝⁿ → ℤ measurable with w Lebesgue integrable on A, and G differentiable at every u ∈ A. Let Ĝ : ℝ^{n+1} → ℝ^{N+1}, Â ⊆ ℝ^{n+1} and ŵ : ℝ^{n+1} → ℤ satisfy Ĝ(z) = ι(z_0, G(tail z)) for all z, Â = {z : z_0 ∈ (0, 1) and tail z ∈ A} and ŵ(z) = w(tail z) for all z, where ι(t, x) := (t, x) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))), z_0 := WithLp.ofLp z 0 and tail z := WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.tail (WithLp.ofLp z)). Then Ĝ is max(1, L)-Lipschitz, Â is Borel, ŵ is measurable, ŵ is integrable on Â, and for every test form ω ∈ 𝒟^{n+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) and every n-form η on ℝ^N satisfying η(x)(v) = ∫_0^1 ω(ι(t, x))(e₀, Jv_0, …, Jv_{n−1}) dt for all x ∈ ℝ^N and v ∈ (ℝ^N)ⁿ (e₀ := EuclideanSpace.single 0 1, J x := ι(0, x)), ∫_A w(u)·η(G(u))(DG(u)e_0, …, DG(u)e_{n−1}) du = ∫_Â ŵ(z)·ω(Ĝ(z))(DĜ(z)ê_0, …, DĜ(z)ê_n) dz, with D = fderiv ℝ and e_a, ê_a the standard bases.
